title: MpxR Cleaves a Periplasmic Fluorescent Reporter Independently of the Canonical Heat-Shock Regulators
authors: Juno Bell, Arun Elsen, and Mira Wen | Fictional Membrane Protease Laboratory
research_question: Does MpxR cleave a periplasmic reporter, and is cleavage dependent on DnaK, DnaJ, sigma32, or FtsH?
key_findings: DnaK, DnaJ, sigma32, and FtsH depletion did not materially reduce cleavage
numeric_findings: less than 12% change after regulator depletion
conclusion: MpxR catalytic activity cleaves the reporter independently of the tested heat-shock regulators.
critical_negations: The heat-shock regulators were not required
The paper is not primarily about DnaK or sigma32
forbidden_claims: FtsH was the protease that cleaved the reporter
The paper is a heat-shock review
